mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE months AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') AS m, 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n MONTH), '%Y-%m'), n + 1 FROM months WHERE n < #{months} ) SELECT months.m AS name, IFNULL(t.c, 0) AS value FROM months LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sign_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS c FROM adoption_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ADOPTED' GROUP BY ym ) t ON t.ym = months.m ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT pc.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pet p INNER JOIN pet_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id AND pc.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status != 'OFFLINE' GROUP BY pc.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT s.city AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pet p INNER JOIN shelter s ON s.id = p.shelter_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'AVAILABLE' GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT '已提交' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM adoption_application WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT '进入审核', COUNT(*) FROM adoption_application WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('REVIEWING','INTERVIEW','HOME_VISIT','APPROVED','SIGNED','ADOPTED') UNION ALL SELECT '审核通过', COUNT(*) FROM adoption_application WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('APPROVED','SIGNED','ADOPTED') UNION ALL SELECT '领养完成', COUNT(*) FROM adoption_application WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ADOPTED'
